headline: DCM Shriram International: SEBI Takeover Regulation 10(6) Disclosure of Exempted Acquisition
sum: Alok Bansidhar Shriram filed a regulatory disclosure with NSE under SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011 Regulation 10(6), reporting an acquisition made in reliance on an exemption from the requirement to make a public offer.
detail: Under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, acquisitions that would otherwise trigger a mandatory public offer may be exempted under Regulation 10 if they meet specified criteria (e.g., acquisitions by promoters, existing shareholders, or in certain restructuring contexts). Even when exempted, Regulation 10(6) mandates disclosure to the stock exchange. The filing confirms Alok Bansidhar Shriram's compliance with this disclosure requirement.
